From 7352e1d5932a0e777e39fa4b619801191f57e603 Mon Sep 17 00:00:00 2001
From: Marc Kleine-Budde <mkl@pengutronix.de>
Date: Tue, 23 Dec 2025 21:21:39 +0100
Subject: [PATCH] can: gs_usb: gs_usb_receive_bulk_callback(): fix URB memory
 leak

In gs_can_open(), the URBs for USB-in transfers are allocated, added to the
parent->rx_submitted anchor and submitted. In the complete callback
gs_usb_receive_bulk_callback(), the URB is processed and resubmitted. In
gs_can_close() the URBs are freed by calling
usb_kill_anchored_urbs(parent->rx_submitted).

However, this does not take into account that the USB framework unanchors
the URB before the complete function is called. This means that once an
in-URB has been completed, it is no longer anchored and is ultimately not
released in gs_can_close().

Fix the memory leak by anchoring the URB in the
gs_usb_receive_bulk_callback() to the parent->rx_submitted anchor.

Fixes: d08e973a77d1 ("can: gs_usb: Added support for the GS_USB CAN devices")
Cc: stable@vger.kernel.org
Link: https://patch.msgid.link/20260105-gs_usb-fix-memory-leak-v2-1-cc6ed6438034@pengutronix.de
Signed-off-by: Marc Kleine-Budde <mkl@pengutronix.de>

diff --git a/drivers/net/can/usb/gs_usb.c b/drivers/net/can/usb/gs_usb.c
index a0233e550a5a..d093babbc320 100644
--- a/drivers/net/can/usb/gs_usb.c
+++ b/drivers/net/can/usb/gs_usb.c
@@ -751,6 +751,8 @@ static void gs_usb_receive_bulk_callback(struct urb *urb)
 			  hf, parent->hf_size_rx,
 			  gs_usb_receive_bulk_callback, parent);
 
+	usb_anchor_urb(urb, &parent->rx_submitted);
+
 	rc = usb_submit_urb(urb, GFP_ATOMIC);
 
 	/* USB failure take down all interfaces */
-- 
2.34.1

The patch fixes a memory leak in the `gs_usb` CAN driver by ensuring that URBs are re-anchored after completion, so they can be properly freed during device close.

## Modifications in each file:

**File: `drivers/net/can/usb/gs_usb.c`**

- In the function `gs_usb_receive_bulk_callback()`, a single line is added:
  ```c
  usb_anchor_urb(urb, &parent->rx_submitted);
  ```
  This call is placed immediately before `usb_submit_urb()` within the callback's resubmission path.

## Relationship between modifications:

- The patch addresses an asymmetry in URB lifecycle management. In `gs_can_open()`, URBs are anchored to `parent->rx_submitted` and then submitted. Upon completion, the USB core **unanchors** the URB before invoking the callback. Consequently, when `gs_can_close()` calls `usb_kill_anchored_urbs()`, URBs that have already been processed (and are no longer anchored) are not freed, causing a memory leak.
- By adding `usb_anchor_urb()` in the callback (before resubmitting the URB), the URB is re‑anchored to the same list. This ensures that every URB remains anchored as long as it is in use, allowing `gs_can_close()` to properly kill and free all URBs, thereby fixing the leak.
- The change is minimal and localized to the receive callback, ensuring the fix does not affect other parts of the driver.

The code statements that lead to the bug are:
<text>usb_fill_bulk_urb(urb, parent->udev, parent->pipe_in, hf, parent->hf_size_rx, gs_usb_receive_bulk_callback, parent);
rc = usb_submit_urb(urb, GFP_ATOMIC);</text>
Reason:
The URB is resubmitted without being re-anchored to parent->rx_submitted. Since the USB core unanchors the URB before the completion callback, after resubmission it is no longer anchored. When gs_can_close() calls usb_kill_anchored_urbs(), it only kills anchored URBs, so these unanchored URBs are not freed, causing a memory leak.

The code statements that fix the bug are:
<text>usb_anchor_urb(urb, &parent->rx_submitted);</text>
Reason:
By anchoring the URB to parent->rx_submitted before resubmission, the URB remains anchored after submission. This ensures that when gs_can_close() calls usb_kill_anchored_urbs(), all in-flight URBs (including resubmitted ones) are killed and freed, preventing the memory leak.
